name: calendar
useFor: Use inline when the dates are the content (a delivery window, an availability view); in a field use Date Picker. Choose mode single, multiple or range, disable days that cannot be picked, and set captionLayout to dropdown for dates far away.
constraints: Colors other than the blue for selection
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the keys, the pale blue of a highlighted row and the mono table figures)
title: Calendar
description: A month grid of 36px keys: today in blue, the chosen day the blue key, a range on the pale blue.
